summary.text: Kirk Cullimore is a Republican state senator from Utah who has represented District 19 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Shana Anderson.
An attorney, he has served as Senate majority leader since January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Kirk Cullimore earned an associate degree from Utah Valley University in 1997, a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 2000, and a law degree from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2008.
His professional experience includes work as an attorney.
Cullimore was first elected to the Utah State Senate in 2018 and was re-elected in 2022.

In 2021 he sponsored SB 2004, which allowed employees to opt out of an employer's vaccine requirement for medical or religious reasons or for a "sincerely held personal belief"; Gov. Spencer Cox signed it on November 16, 2021.
Ballotpedia reports that Cullimore said the Legislature's 2025 priorities would include energy, the economy and housing.
